post.title: Paid your card in full? Why your score can still drop
post.ig:
Paid your card in full? Your score can still drop. Here's why.
Issuers usually report the balance from your statement, before the due date (myFICO, Experian).
Amounts owed is 30% of a FICO Score (myFICO). Our math: $2,000 on a $2,500 limit = 80% utilization.
In March 2026, 800+ FICO scorers used 6.4% of card limits on average; poor scores (300-579), 76.8% (Experian).
Classic scores like FICO 8 use your latest reported balance, so the hit fades once a lower balance reports; FICO 10T looks at 24 months of trended data.
Experian says 30% is no magic cutoff: lower utilization is better.
Sources: myFICO; Experian State of Credit Cards (March 2026 data); Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
